name: NavigationBar
purpose: Deprecated alias of NavigationTitle (slug navigation-title). Same stack chrome (title, back, bar items). Prefer NavigationTitle / contracts/navigation-title. Kept so contracts/navigation-bar and import path @chameleon-ui/components-react/navigation-bar keep resolving.
scenarios: Legacy import path for stack title chrome after rename to NavigationTitle

backLabel.description: Previous controller title on the back control. Default Back.

leading.description: Leading slot when there is no back control.

states.name: nested
states.description: Stack depth > 1; back control pops to the previous title.

antiPatterns: Prefer NavigationTitle (navigation-title) for new code; this slug is a deprecated alias.
Do not put root destinations here; those belong on Navigation.

keyboard: Tab moves through back and trailing controls
a11y.focus: Back is a real button; the title is a heading.
a11y.labeling: The title is an h1 of the current screen; back uses the previous title as its label.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS; the back chevron mirrors under [dir=rtl].

mechanics: Deprecated alias of NavigationTitle. Implementation lives under packages/components-react/src/navigation-title. Import NavigationBar or NavigationTitle from the umbrella; both resolve to the same component. Prefer get_contract('navigation-title') and slug navigation-title for new agents.
usage: NavigationBar remains exported as a deprecated alias for EraseLab and existing consumers.
